idea-plugin.name: GitHub MCP Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Adds tools to the IDE's built-in MCP server that drive the bundled GitHub plugin UI, so MCP clients such as Claude Code can open pull requests in the IDE.

The tools only open and show things in the IDE. They never modify data on GitHub.

This is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitHub or JetBrains.

Tools

  • github_list_repositories — lists the project's GitHub repositories, the selected one and the GitHub account.
  • github_select_repository — selects the repository of the Pull Requests tool window and shows its pull request list.
  • github_open_pull_request_details, github_open_pull_request_timeline, github_open_pull_request_diff — show a pull request's details (in the tool window), timeline or diff (in an editor tab).
  • github_open_pull_request_list — shows (and optionally reloads) the pull request list.
  • github_close_pull_request_details, github_close_pull_request_timeline, github_close_pull_request_diff — close those views of pull requests. Do not close pull requests on GitHub.
  • github_close_tool_window — hides the Pull Requests tool window.
  • github_get_pull_request_filter — returns the filter of the pull request list.
  • github_set_pull_request_filter — sets the filter of the pull request list (state, author, assignee, label, review state, sort, search query).
